content.title: MI vs RCB Highlights, IPL 2026: Mumbai Indians suffer third defeat this season as RCB win by 18 runs
content.text: After two back-to-back double headers over the weekend, the action now shifts to Hyderabad, where Sunrisers Hyderabad host table-toppers Rajasthan Royals at the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium on Monday.Royal Challengers Bengaluru skipper Rajat Patidar produced a breathtaking assault at the Wankhede Stadium, scripting history by equalling a long-standing Indian Premier League record during a high-octane clash against Mumbai Indians on Sunday.Patidar smashed a stunning 53 off just 20 balls, reaching his half-century in just 17 deliveries — matching the record set by Adam Gilchrist back in 2009 for the fastest fifty by a captain in IPL history. The Deccan Chargers legend had achieved the feat against Delhi in Centurion, and 17 years later, Patidar joined him at the top in emphatic fashion.Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) may have roared back to winning ways with a commanding 18-run victory over Mumbai Indians at the Wankhede Stadium, but the spotlight quickly shifted to a worrying development involving Virat Kohli.The RCB talisman, who scored a composed 50 off 38 balls, did not take the field during Mumbai’s chase due to an ankle issue, leaving fans concerned. Kohli was seen watching from the dressing room in a jacket, with youngster Jacob Bethell replacing him in the outfield.🏏Cricket Match PredictionHow exciting was this match?Tap to make your predictionRCB vs MI Live Score: The RCB vs MI clash at Wankhede produced one of the highest-scoring gamesThe RCB vs MI clash at Wankhede produced one of the highest-scoring games of the season, with Royal Challengers Bengaluru posting 240/4 and Mumbai Indians replying with 222/5. It was a match defined by explosive batting, but ultimately controlled by RCB’s superior top-order dominance.Statistically, 240/4 stands as one of RCB’s strongest totals against MI, while MI’s 222/5 became their highest-ever score against Bengaluru in IPL history. Phil Salt, Virat Kohli, and Rajat Patidar all scored half-centuries in a rare collective batting display.Sherfane Rutherford’s unbeaten 71 off 31 balls became one of the standout innings from a lower-order batter this season, featuring nine sixes. Despite this, MI’s middle overs without a single six proved decisive.RCB’s bowlers, particularly Krunal Pandya and Suyash Sharma, controlled the crucial phases between overs 8–15, preventing MI from building sustained momentum.Historically, RCB have now won multiple recent encounters against MI at Wankhede after a long losing streak at the venue, signalling a shift in their away form dominance.The match reinforced RCB’s batting depth and MI’s ongoing struggle to control phases of the game, especially in high-scoring conditions.RCB vs MI Live Score: Hardik Pandya admitted that his team’s inability to control powerplaysMumbai Indians captain Hardik Pandya admitted that his team’s inability to control powerplays and momentum shifts continues to cost them matches. After the 18-run defeat to RCB, he acknowledged that MI are repeatedly “catching up” instead of dictating terms.Hardik pointed out both batting and bowling inconsistencies, especially during the first six overs. He emphasized the need for reflection and tactical reassessment ahead of upcoming matches. MI have struggled to control early phases of games, which has forced them into difficult chase scenarios or defensive bowling positions.He also addressed tactical decisions around batting first or chasing, suggesting the team may need to reconsider their approach depending on conditions. Despite the loss, Hardik remained optimistic about regrouping during the break before their next fixture.On Sherfane Rutherford’s explosive knock, Hardik was full of praise, calling it a sign of the team’s batting potential and depth. However, he admitted that individual brilliance alone is not enough without collective execution.MI will now look to fix their early-game struggles and regain momentum in the tournament.RCB vs MI Live Score: Mumbai Indians fought hardMumbai Indians fought hard in their chase of 241 but ultimately fell short by 18 runs despite a stunning late innings from Sherfane Rutherford. The impact substitute produced a breathtaking 71 off 31 balls, including a flurry of nine sixes, but the target proved too steep.MI’s innings never found full stability. Ryan Rickelton got them off to a quick start with 37 off 22 balls, but Rohit Sharma’s early retirement hurt momentum. Even after Suryakumar Yadav and Hardik Pandya tried to rebuild, wickets at regular intervals kept MI behind the required rate.RCB’s bowlers maintained pressure throughout the middle overs, ensuring MI went through a crucial phase without big hits. Krunal Pandya and Suyash Sharma played key roles in breaking partnerships and slowing scoring.Rutherford’s late fireworks briefly revived hopes, as he dominated the death overs with clean hitting over the boundary. However, the required rate and early damage left MI too much to do.In the end, MI finished on 222/5, falling short in a match dominated by RCB’s top-order brilliance.🏏Cricket Match PredictionRate RCB's performance in this matchTap to make your predictionRCB vs MI Live Score: Rajat Patidar delivered one of the most destructive innings of the seasonRajat Patidar delivered one of the most destructive innings of the season, smashing a 17-ball fifty as Royal Challengers Bengaluru tore apart Mumbai Indians’ bowling attack. His fearless hitting in the middle overs ensured RCB maintained their scoring momentum after a strong start.Coming in after the solid opening stand between Phil Salt and Virat Kohli, Patidar immediately shifted gears. He targeted spin and pace alike, clearing boundaries with ease and putting MI’s bowlers under severe pressure. His innings of 53 off 20 balls featured clean striking and confident shot selection.Patidar later credited the openers for setting the platform, saying their partnership gave the team clarity and freedom. He also highlighted his comfort against fast bowling on this surface, which he described as ideal for stroke play.His aggressive approach complemented Kohli’s anchoring role and Salt’s explosive start perfectly. Alongside Tim David’s late cameo, Patidar ensured RCB crossed the massive 240-run mark.His innings proved to be a decisive phase of the match, as MI’s bowling attack never recovered from the onslaught, eventually allowing RCB to dictate the contest from start to finish.RCB vs MI Live Score: Phil Salt was named Player of the MatchPhil Salt was named Player of the Match for his explosive 78 off just 36 balls, a knock that set the tone for Royal Challengers Bengaluru’s dominant total of 240/4 against Mumbai Indians. His fearless approach at the top dismantled MI’s bowling attack and gave RCB the perfect platform.Salt admitted after the match that consistency in T20 cricket is difficult, but impact matters more than accumulation. He stressed the importance of maintaining an aggressive mindset, especially on batting-friendly surfaces like the Wankhede. His innings included clean hitting against both pace and spin, ensuring MI were under pressure from the very beginning.He shared a 120-run opening stand with Virat Kohli, who played the perfect supporting role. While Kohli rotated strike and anchored the innings, Salt took calculated risks and punished loose deliveries. His dismissal did not slow RCB’s momentum, as Rajat Patidar and Tim David carried forward the attack.Salt also praised RCB’s batting depth, noting that the team still felt they left runs in the middle overs. His performance once again highlighted his value as an aggressive top-order batter capable of changing games within a few overs.RCB vs MI Live Score: Royal Challengers Bengaluru produced a complete batting masterclassRoyal Challengers Bengaluru produced a complete batting masterclass to defeat Mumbai Indians by 18 runs in a high-scoring IPL 2026 clash at the Wankhede Stadium. In a match filled with explosive hitting, RCB posted a commanding 240/4 in their 20 overs, setting up a total MI eventually fell short of despite a late charge.The foundation was laid by Phil Salt and Virat Kohli, who added a blazing opening stand that put MI immediately under pressure. Salt’s fearless intent set the tone as he raced to a quick fifty, while Kohli anchored the innings with controlled aggression. The momentum continued when skipper Rajat Patidar walked in and unleashed a brutal counterattack, racing to a 17-ball fifty.Tim David’s quick cameo at the end ensured RCB crossed the 240-mark, leaving MI with a mountain to climb. Despite a strong batting lineup on paper, Mumbai never fully recovered after early setbacks, including Rohit Sharma’s injury retirement.RCB’s bowling unit then executed their plans effectively, striking at key moments and preventing MI from building sustained partnerships. The result extended RCB’s strong run of form, while MI were left searching for answers after another high-scoring defeat at home.RCB vs MI Live Score: RCB beat MI by 18 runs to get back to winning waysMumbai Indians finish strongly at 222/5, hammering 26 runs off the final over from Romario Shepherd, but it is not enough as Royal Challengers Bengaluru hold on for an 18-run victory after posting a massive 240/4.Sherfane Rutherford produces a late blitz, launching a series of clean strikes including two towering sixes over square leg and sweeper cover, and even survives a no-ball scare as Shepherd’s waist-high full toss is ruled legal after a review. Despite the carnage at the end, MI’s chase falls short due to earlier wickets and a mounting required rate.RCB’s huge total, built on explosive top-order batting, ultimately proves decisive on a high-scoring Wankhede surface. MI fight till the end but the damage from the middle overs leaves them too much to chase in the final stretch.RCB win by 18 runs, sealing a thrilling run-fest at the Wankhede.RCB vs MI Live Score: MI close to losingMumbai Indians reach 196/5 after 19 overs, collecting 9 runs off Bhuvneshwar Kumar in a tense, tightly controlled over that keeps the chase alive but leaves everything for the final over. Sherfane Rutherford continues to fight hard, finding a crucial boundary with a flick off a low full-toss and rotating strike efficiently despite disciplined bowling.Bhuvneshwar lands several pinpoint yorkers and full deliveries, restricting free scoring for large parts of the over.MI 196/5 in 19 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: 21 runs off the 18th overMumbai Indians surge to 187/5 after 18 overs, as Sherfane Rutherford unleashes a brutal assault in a chaotic 21-run over from Jacob Duffy. The over is packed with drama—multiple wides, reviews, and repeated interruptions—but Rutherford keeps his composure amid the chaos.He clears the ropes twice with powerful hits over deep mid-wicket and long-on, punishing anything even slightly short or in the slot. Mitchell Santner provides support at the other end with a couple of steady rotations, ensuring the strike stays with the set batter.Despite the stop-start nature of the over and RCB’s desperate reviews, MI extract maximum damage, keeping the chase alive. However, with wickets in hand limited and pressure still high, the finishing phase promises to be tense.MI 187/5 in 18 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Huge task ahead for MumbaiMumbai Indians move to 157/5 in 16 overs after a chaotic and stop-start over that swings wildly between hope and setbacks. Sherfane Rutherford provides early fireworks with a massive six over deep mid-wicket, but the momentum is disrupted by a no-ball that gives MI a brief lift despite a sharp catch going to waste.Rasikh Salam Dar continues to struggle physically, pulling up again with cramps, forcing another stoppage and a timeout, adding to the disruption in an already tense chase. Naman Dhir’s dismissal earlier in the over further dents MI’s hopes, while Mitchell Santner keeps things ticking with a single.Despite flashes of aggression, MI’s innings is losing rhythm at a crucial stage, with interruptions and wickets making the chase increasingly difficult.MI 157/5 in 16 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Mumbai Indians slip slightly at 147/4Mumbai Indians slip slightly at 147/4 in 15 overs after a mixed 9-run over from Jacob Duffy that sees Hardik Pandya fall after a superb innings. Hardik looks in fine touch with a boundary earlier in the over, but perishes attempting an expansive shot, edging a wide delivery to deep backward point.Sherfane Rutherford keeps MI in the hunt with a sharp flick for a single off a wide ball, while Naman Dhir gets off the mark calmly. There’s a brief pause with a change of ball, adding a twist to the chase. Despite the wicket, MI still have firepower left as the required rate continues to climb.MI 147/4 in 15 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Mumbai Indians keep up the momentumMumbai Indians keep up the momentum, reaching 138/3 in 14 overs with a solid 14-run over off Suyash Sharma. Hardik Pandya continues to anchor the chase with authority, striking a boundary and rotating the strike well, while Sherfane Rutherford provides the spark with a towering six over deep square leg.There’s a good balance of aggression and control as both batters find gaps and keep the scoreboard moving. Despite earlier breakthroughs, MI stay in the hunt with positive intent, setting up an intriguing phase ahead.MI 138/3 in 14 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Mumbai Indians suffer Suryakumar Yadav blowMumbai Indians slip further to 124/3 after 13 overs, managing just five runs off Krunal Pandya, who also picks up a crucial wicket. Krunal keeps things tight with clever variations, including a surprise bouncer, as RCB tighten their grip on the contest.MI 124/3 in 13 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Suryakumar Yadav plays a supporting roleMumbai Indians continue to keep the chase alive, moving to 108/2 after 11 overs, with nine runs coming off Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Hardik Pandya leads the charge, striking two boundaries—one swatted fine down the leg side and another lofted straight down the ground with control.Pandya looks in ominous touch despite missing out on a full toss, while Suryakumar Yadav plays a supporting role at the other end. Bhuvneshwar mixes his lengths well but still leaks runs at key moments.MI 108/2 in 11 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Mumbai Indians regain momentumMumbai Indians regain momentum, reaching 99/2 after 10 overs, with a strong 14-run over off Suyash Sharma. The partnership builds nicely, keeping MI firmly in the hunt as they approach the halfway mark of the chase.MI 99/2 in 10 overs in chase of 241IPL Live Score: Mumbai Indians slow down slightlyMumbai Indians slow down slightly, reaching 85/2 after nine overs, with just five runs coming off Krunal Pandya’s over. RCB burn a review on an LBW appeal against Suryakumar that is clearly sliding down leg.MI 85/2 in 9 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: MI lose two wickets in single over in 241 chaseMumbai Indians suffer a dramatic setback, slipping to 80/2 after eight overs, as Suyash Sharma turns the game with a double strike. Suryakumar Yadav continues at the crease, but the momentum clearly shifts after the twin blows.MI 80/2 in 8 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Mumbai Indians keep the chase on trackMumbai Indians keep the chase on track, moving to 72/0 after seven overs, with 10 runs coming off Krunal Pandya. Dar keeps things tight with disciplined bowling, limiting the scoring opportunities.MI 62/0 in 6 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Krunal keeps things tightMumbai Indians continue their steady progress, moving to 56/0 after five overs, with Krunal Pandya conceding just eight runs in a controlled over. However, the late boundary ensures MI maintain momentum in the powerplay.MI 48/0 in 4 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: 18 runs off third overMumbai Indians step on the accelerator, racing to 39/0 after three overs with a massive 18-run over off Jacob Duffy. While Bhuvneshwar starts with a wide and mixes his lengths, MI manage to find boundaries and maintain a healthy tempo early in the chase.MI 21/0 in 2 overs in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: Rohit Sharma, Ryan Rickelton in the middle, Jacob Duffy starts with the ballMumbai Indians begin their chase with a steady 10/0 in the first over, courtesy of Ryan Rickelton’s positive intent against Jacob Duffy. Rickelton gets going with a crisp six over deep mid-wicket and follows it up with a well-timed boundary through covers.There is some movement on offer early, with a couple of play-and-misses keeping things interesting, but Rickelton looks confident as he takes on the bowler. Rohit Sharma is yet to face, with Rickelton dominating the strike.MI 10/0 in 1 over in chase of 241RCB vs MI Live Score: RCB post 240/4 in 20 overs against MI in MumbaiRoyal Challengers Bengaluru pile up a mammoth 240/4 at the Wankhede Stadium, making full use of what appears to be a batting paradise. The foundation is laid early by Phil Salt, whose explosive start puts immediate pressure on the bowlers. From there, Rajat Patidar takes centre stage, producing a sensational knock that completely dismantles the Mumbai Indians attack. The skipper’s breathtaking 17-ball fifty shifts the momentum heavily in RCB’s favour and leaves MI searching for answers.Virat Kohli also contributes with a composed half-century. While his strike rate isn’t as explosive as his partners, he smartly plays the anchor role, allowing the likes of Salt and Patidar to dominate. His presence ensures stability even as wickets fall at the other end. In the death overs, Tim David provides the finishing touches with a powerful cameo, including a towering six off the final ball to push the total to a daunting mark.For MI, it proves to be a tough outing with the ball. Most of their attack goes the distance on a flat surface, though Jasprit Bumrah once again stands out with his relative control and discipline. Trent Boult picks up a late wicket, but the damage is largely done by then. Adding to their struggles, MI are also slow with their over-rate, taking over two hours to complete their innings in the field.With 240 on the board, RCB have done more than half the job, but MI possess a formidable batting line-up capable of chasing big totals. Having already hunted down a 220-plus score earlier in the tournament, the big question now is whether they can produce another special effort under pressure. The chase promises to be a blockbuster.RCB vs MI Live Score: Can RCB reach 250?Royal Challengers Bengaluru continue their late surge, climbing to 230/3 after 19 overs with 13 runs off Jasprit Bumrah’s final over.
